description:
## Kampala Institute of Science and Technology (KIST)

**Kampala Institute of Science and Technology (KIST)** is a registered higher education institution in Uganda dedicated to providing quality training in science, technology and health-related programmes. KIST equips students with practical skills and knowledge to meet the demands of the healthcare and technology sectors.

## Bursaries Available: Diploma in Orthopaedic Medicine

KIST is pleased to announce that **bursaries are still available** for the **Diploma in Orthopaedic Medicine** programme. This is an excellent opportunity for students who wish to pursue a career in orthopaedic medicine but may need financial support to fund their studies.

### About the Programme

The Diploma in Orthopaedic Medicine at KIST provides comprehensive training in the assessment, diagnosis and management of musculoskeletal conditions. Students gain practical skills in orthopaedic examination, fracture management, rehabilitation and patient care. The programme prepares graduates to work in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centres and community health settings across Uganda and beyond.

### Why Choose KIST

- Qualified and experienced teaching staff
- Hands-on clinical training in real healthcare settings
- Modern facilities and learning resources
- Bursary support to reduce the financial burden on students
- A strong track record of graduate employment in the health sector
- Located in Kampala with easy access to clinical placement sites

### Who Should Apply

- Students who have completed O-Level or A-Level and wish to pursue a career in orthopaedic medicine
- Health workers looking to upgrade their qualifications in orthopaedic care
- Anyone passionate about musculoskeletal health and patient rehabilitation

### How to Apply for the Bursary

Interested students should send their application through any of the following channels:

📱 **WhatsApp:** 0761 598 030

📧 **Email:** kistsecretary@gmail.com

📞 **General Enquiries:** 0779 837 314

🌐 **Website:** www.kist.ac.ug

📧 **Info Email:** info@kist.ac.ug

📞 **Additional Contact:** 0761 668 023

### Important Notes

- Bursaries are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis
- Applicants should indicate their interest in the Diploma in Orthopaedic Medicine when applying
- Supporting academic documents may be required during the application process
- For more information about entry requirements, programme duration and fees, contact KIST directly using the details above
